youtube.title: Quackers' Farm Animal Sounds! (QUACK!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦆 QUACK! Quackers the duck quacked so loud that all the farm friends ran away! Can you help bring them back?

Learn farm animal names and the sounds they make with Quackers on the farm: the cow says moo, the pig says oink, the dog says woof, the cat says meow, the frog says ribbit and the bird says tweet! Each friend comes back one by one, then sing the animal sounds song with Quackers. Stay till the end, because a surprise friend peeks out of the pond! 🫧

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 6 animal names: cow, pig, dog, cat, frog and bird
✔️ Learn the sound each animal makes (moo, oink, woof, meow, ribbit, tweet)
✔️ Practice making animal sounds out loud with Quackers
✔️ Sing a catchy farm animal sounds song!
